script.text:
set -euxo pipefail
apt-get update && apt-get install -y osmium-tool gdal-bin curl ca-certificates tar
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
mkdir -p /var/tmp/geodashing-work/app
cd /var/tmp/geodashing-work/app
TOKEN=$(curl -s -f -H "Metadata-Flavor: Google" "http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token" | sed -n 's/.*"access_token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
curl -f -L -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" "https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/geodashing-v2-map-data/o/batch%2Fgeodashing-roads-bundle.tar.gz?alt=media" -o bundle.tar.gz
tar -xzf bundle.tar.gz
rm -f bundle.tar.gz
uv sync --no-dev
curl -L --fail --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 https://planet.openstreetmap.org/pbf/planet-latest.osm.pbf -o /var/tmp/geodashing-work/planet-latest.osm.pbf
uv run --no-sync python -m backend.scripts.prepare_roads --input /var/tmp/geodashing-work/planet-latest.osm.pbf --output /var/tmp/geodashing-work/world_drivable_roads.gpkg --delete-input --upload-gcs
